newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean SKC's IPO subscription price revised up.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean SKC's IPO subscription price revised up.

text.p: The subscription price for the initial public offering of shares by South Korea's SKC Ltd has been revised to 15,000 won per share from the previous 14,000 won, underwriter Daewoo Securities said on Wednesday.
The revision was based on the result of the book-building, whereby institutions are asked to indicate the amount of shares they want and the price they are willing to pay, Daewoo said.
As a result of the book-building to sell 960,000 shares, or 20 percent of the planned offering of 4.8 million shares, the price per share was set at 19,300 won, it said.
Public subscription for the offering is due on June 19-20.
Choi Jong-hyun, chairman of the Sunkyong Group, and his relatives hold the largest stake of 67.92 percent in SKC, a maker of polyester films and other petrochemical products.
